image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of several audio cassette tapes stacked on a textured surface. The primary subject is a transparent Philips 'MCX 90' cassette in the foreground, showing internal spools and magnetic tape. Behind it are other cassettes, including one with a white paper label. The image has a strong blue color cast and a vintage film aesthetic, indicated by the orange frame border text ('RUP100', '465').
